name: Akatsubaki Torae
source:
"Ah?! If you touch my building, you'll be blown away!"

A super high school level architect who designs, draws, designs and even builds buildings herself. Because of such a job, she usually shows herself as a leadership figure. However, she has a strong tendency to be violent because she hangs out with the tough guys at the construction site.

The tattoo on her arm reads 'no build, no god'. It means 'there is no God without architecture'.
She is very proud of herself and will not acknowledge others until others acknowledge her.

If Misako has the role of leading the group like a model student, Torae has the role of leading the group with strong charisma and violence. Therefore, although the two often have friction during the work, it is fortunate that there is no bloodshed due to the nature of Misako, who knows how to control herself.
